captions.start: Heel to toe: hold for 30 seconds

steps.text: Stand next to a counter with one hand near it.
Put one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching toe.
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch feet.

safety: Always keep one hand near the counter.
If you wobble, step out or hold the counter: that is the safe thing to do.

mistakes.label: feet_not_in_line
mistakes.wrong: your feet were side by side or apart instead of one in front of the other
mistakes.right: Place one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching toe.

mistakes.label: leaning
mistakes.wrong: you leaned on the counter or to the side
mistakes.right: Stand upright with a light touch on the counter, rather than leaning your weight on it or to the side.

setup: Stand next to a counter, facing the phone.
